label.en: 1. Modules We Do Provide (Active Core & Operational)

tiers.description: These modules are currently active, fully calibrated with sanitized clinical language, and part of the core academy and infrastructure tracks.
tiers.description_ar: هذه البرامج مفعّلة حالياً بالكامل ومعايرة بلغة سريرية دقيقة، وتشكل المسارات الأساسية للأكاديمية والبنية التحتية.

modules.title: Internal Medicine & Pathophysiology (MTC™ 1.0)
modules.focus: High-yield internal medicine review focusing on acute care, fluid management, DKA, and ABG interpretation.

modules.title: General Surgery & Trauma Emergencies (MTC™ 2.0)
modules.focus: Practical approach to surgical emergencies, acute abdomen triage, and hemorrhagic shock resuscitation.

modules.title: Obstetrics & Gynecology (MTC™ 3.0)
modules.focus: Essential OB/GYN clinical guidelines, PPH protocols, pre-eclampsia management, and CTG interpretation.

modules.title: Pediatrics & Neonatology (MTC™ 4.0)
modules.focus: Core pediatric care, NRP algorithms, dehydration, and pediatric airway management.

modules.title: Medical Ethics & Forensic Medicine (MTC™ 5.0)
modules.focus: Medical law, informed consent, death certification, and forensic traumatology.

modules.title: Clinical Pharmacology & Toxicology (MTC™ 6.0)
modules.focus: Applied pharmacology, antimicrobial stewardship, and emergency toxicology.

modules.title: Diagnostic Radiology & Lab Medicine (MTC™ 7.0)
modules.focus: Chest X-ray interpretation, emergency brain CTs, and FAST ultrasounds.

modules.title: Community Medicine & Epidemiology (MTC™ 8.0)
modules.focus: Outbreak investigation, vaccination schedules, and biostatistics.

modules.title: MRCS Part A: Foundation Sciences & Critical Care
modules.title_ar: زمالة الجراحة البريطانية MRCS Part A
modules.focus: Comprehensive preparation for the Intercollegiate MRCS Part A exam.

modules.title: German Medical License (Approbation) & FSP Track
modules.focus: Complete language and clinical pathway for medical licensing in Germany.

modules.title: Basic Surgical Skills (BSS-1 & BSS-2) Cairo Cohort
modules.focus: Hands-on simulation covering suturing geometry, anastomoses, and laparoscopy.

modules.title: Basic Life Support (BLS) & CPR Certification
modules.title_ar: شهادة الدعم الحياتي الأساسي والإنعاش القلبي (BLS)
modules.focus: Official AHA-compliant clinical resuscitation training (Dokki Cairo hands-on + Kuwait online accredited track).

modules.title: GeneAcademy Molecular Medicine Series (DNA, RNA, Oncology, CRISPR, and WES)
modules.title_ar: سلسلة الطب الجزيئي 1.0 إلى 8.0 (DNA, RNA, Oncology, CRISPR, WES)
modules.focus: Advanced genetic architecture, clinical transcriptomics, and next-generation sequencing pipelines.

modules.title: 15:5:1 Research Pods: Translational Oncology
modules.focus: Active research mentorship investigating ctDNA and cell-free RNA signatures.

modules.title: The 100 Papers Project & Thesis Support
modules.focus: Academic rescue for displaced researchers and stalled theses.

modules.title: GLOMEt B2B Infrastructure & Reagent Supply Chain
modules.title_ar: تجهيز المختبرات الطبية وسلاسل إمداد الكواشف (GLOMEt)
modules.focus: Turnkey medical laboratory setup and cold-chain logistics.

tiers.description: These represent natural extensions of our existing tracks that are scaled for secondary deployment based on regional demand and faculty bandwidth.
tiers.description_ar: تمثل هذه البرامج توسعات طبيعية لمساراتنا الحالية المجهزة للإطلاق التدريجي وفق متطلبات المنطقة وطاقة الهيئة التدريسية.

modules.title: Advanced Clinical Subspecialties Track (Cardiology, Pulmonology, and Critical Care Fellowships)
modules.title_ar: مسار الزمالات الدقيقة (أمراض القلب، الصدرية، والعناية المركزة)
modules.focus: Expanding past general internal medicine into specialized fellowship preparation.

modules.title: MRCS Part B (OSCE) Simulation Hub
modules.title_ar: مركز المحاكاة السريرية لاختبار MRCS Part B OSCE
modules.focus: Extending our Cairo surgical simulation infrastructure (SKILL-301) into a dedicated physical OSCE training camp.

modules.title: Advanced Clinical Bioinformatics & Diagnostic Genomics
modules.title_ar: المعلوماتية الحيوية السريرية المتقدمة والتشخيص الجينومي
modules.focus: Scaling our MM-108 exome sequencing track into an independent certification for clinical molecular pathologists.

tiers.description: ⚠️ IMPORTANT HIGHLIGHT: Based on our clinical training framework, curriculum gaps, and market positioning, the following modules must be prioritized to secure complete clinical competency, exam readiness, and institutional value:
tiers.description_ar: ⚠️ أولوية قصوى: بناءً على إطار التدريب السريري وسد الفجوات التعليمية، تم وضع هذه الوحدات كأولوية استراتيجية لضمان الكفاءة السريرية الكاملة والجاهزية المهنية:

modules.title: Emergency Medicine & Advanced Trauma Life Support (ATLS) Integration
modules.title_ar: طب الطوارئ والتكامل مع الدعم المتقدم لمصابي الحوادث (ATLS)
modules.focus: Algorithmic emergency room framework covering multi-system trauma stabilization, shock management, and rapid triage workflows.
modules.rationale: While we cover individual internal medicine and surgical trauma emergencies (SMC-101, SMC-102), doctors on the frontline require a dedicated, algorithmic emergency room framework covering multi-system trauma stabilization, shock management, and rapid triage workflows.

modules.title: Clinical Research Methodology, Biostatistics, & Good Clinical Practice (GCP)
modules.title_ar: منهجية الأبحاث السريرية والإحصاء الحيوي والممارسة الإكلينيكية الجيدة (GCP)
modules.focus: Foundational bridge module in protocol design, ethical clearances, and advanced biostatistics before entering high-output publishing pods.
modules.rationale: Our POD-401 and RESC-501 research tracks actively produce papers and theses, but learners need a foundational bridge module in protocol design, ethical clearances, and advanced biostatistics before entering high-output publishing pods.

modules.title: Healthcare Systems, Hospital Management, & Medical Practice Economics
modules.title_ar: أنظمة الرعاية الصحية وإدارة المستشفيات واقتصاديات الممارسة الطبية
modules.focus: Equips doctors with essential business, operational, and regulatory skills required to manage private clinics or modern diagnostic facilities successfully.
modules.rationale: Bridging the gap between clinical licensing (SMC) and B2B infrastructure (GLOMEt), this module equips doctors with essential business, operational, and regulatory skills required to manage private clinics or modern diagnostic facilities successfully.

modules.title: Clinical Documentation & Technical Writing Standards (MTC™ Compliance Module)
modules.title_ar: معايير التوثيق السريري والكتابة الطبية الاحترافية (وحدة الامتثال MTC™)
modules.focus: Mandatory quality assurance training to eradicate tenfold dosing errors, decimal tracking failures, SI unit mislabeling, and binomial nomenclature collisions.

syllabus.rationale: Mislabeled SI units, trailing/missing decimal points, and unstandardized abbreviations introduce fatal vulnerabilities into patient charts.
objectives: Eliminate tenfold dosing errors by enforcing strict metric standards.
Streamline research reporting to international journal publishing standards.

units.unit: Unit 1: The Anatomy of a Medical Error in Documentation
topics: Typography as a clinical safety tool
Hazards of 'The Clinic Way' vs standardized medical writing

units.unit: Unit 2: SI Unit Regulations & Prescription Safety
topics: Safe handling of electrolytes and chemotherapy orders

units.unit: Unit 3: Nosology, Terminology, and Data Harmonization
Unit 4: Institutional Auditing & MTC™ Forensic Review
